Name: Eule27
Description:
As specialists in optical interference coatings, we cover everything from simulation and reverse engineering to automated process control. Our software and consulting services help manufacturers and research facilities increase process reliability, quality, and production efficiency.

Based in Switzerland, Eule27 develops the customized software layer bridging the gap between optical thin-film metrology and your coating systems. Tailored to your requirements, we deliver complete measurement systems or seamlessly integrate with your existing metrology equipment. Driven by embedded physical thin-film models, our EulenControl runtime calculates the exact process adjustments required at any given moment—independent of the machine type. Depending on the architecture of your equipment, EulenControl serves as a decision-support interface for the operator or integrates fully as a closed-loop control system.

Our vision extends beyond direct process control. We are bringing the entire production lifecycle together in the upcoming EulenStudio software suite. Future modules EulenDesign and EulenModel will seamlessly integrate coating development into the workflow, while EulenLearn will analyze completed production runs to drive further data-backed improvements in reproducibility and efficiency.

The EB1s controler is the little sister of the EB1 and is ideal for tumblers, autoclaves, cooking systems, boiling pans, showers, etc.

Ionsmoke is a worldwide unique smoking process using ionisation in which the smoking time can be halved and 98% of the fine dust in the chamber is used up. This saves energy and smoking material and increases the capacity of the smoking system.

HACCP conformity is ensured by the EBLuft software, which is linked to the controls and records and visualizes all processes in the systems.

We analyze your situation, your needs.  We develop, design, deliver. We are also there for you afterwards: maintenance, support, upgrades. Name: Elythor
Description:
Elythor is a Swiss drone manufacturer founded in 2023 as a spin-off from the world-leading Intelligence Systems Lab at EPFL Lausanne, introducing Morpho: the revolutionary shape-shifting UAV designed to endure any weather. Capturing essential data at crucial moments, Morpho exemplifies the fusion of agile flight dynamics and advanced sensor technology—your key to unlocking the aerial analytics of tomorrow.

Whether onshore or offshore, for planned missions or emergency response, within complex spaces or over long distances, we seamlessly integrate it all.

With no downtime required, our drones inspect your assets' integrity and monitor environmental impact at a fraction of the cost.

Connect with us to discover the myriad ways we can tailor solutions to your needs.

Name: RoboMat
Description: We develop and build your custom machine for pharma and medtech applications – including validation and qualification in GMP-compliant execution – as well as for automotive and industrial use. We deliver complete solutions from a single source. Our solutions are as individual as our customers’ requirements.

Name: CTE - ControlTech Engineering AG
Description: ControlTech Engineering is an Industrial Automation company located in Benzburweg 7, Liestal, Switzerland.

Name: foxtec engineering
Description:
foxtec engineering plant und entwickelt moderne Automatisierungssysteme für Prozesse, Maschinen und Anlagen, die unseren Kunden eine gleichbleibende Qualität ihrer Produkte garantieren. Denn gute Produkte ziehen gute Kunden an und machen sie zu Stammkunden.
Zudem erzielen automatisierte Prozesse für unsere Kunden langfristige Kostensenkungen und sichere Arbeitsbedingungen.

Kundennähe ist unsere Devise. Wir hören unseren Kunden zu und entwickeln dann moderne massgeschneiderte Lösungen – getreu unserem Slogan „smart process control„.

Gemeinsam mit unserem Partner bauen wir komplette prozessoptimierte Anlagen, die optimal automatisiert werden können. Damit sind Anlagenbau und Steuerung perfekt aufeinander abgestimmt. Alles aus einer Hand - besser geht's nicht !
Mit über 15 Jahren Erfahrung in der Automatisierung der Lebensmittelbranche sind wir DER kompetente Partner.

Mit unserem Steckenpferd "Käsereisteuerung.CH" haben wir ein Produkt geschaffen, das genau auf die Bedürfnisse von kleinen und mittelgrossen Käsereibetrieben ausgelegt ist. Die modulare Struktur des Systems deckt sämtliche, in einer Käserei vorkommenden Prozesse ab. Hier steckt geballtes Wissen aus unserer langjährigen Praxiserfahrung drin.

Planungs- und Steuerungserfahrung:
Käsereibetriebe, Milchverarbeitung, Pasteurisation, Käsefertiger,Käsepressen, Kocher, CIP-Reinigungen, Salat-/Dipsaucen, Dosieranwendungen, Umkehrosmosen, Filtrieranlagen, Abwasserbehandlung, Holzschnitzelheizungen, H2-Injection zur Optimierung von Holzverbrennungen, Holz- und Metallbearbeitungsmaschinen, Positionier- und Antriebslösungen, Transportsysteme, Sortierautomaten, Förderbänder, Chargenprotokollierung / Traceability, Netzwerke, Virtualisierung, Retrofit, Maschinensicherheit, Fernwartung.

Name: DIGI SENS Switzerland AG
Description:
DIGI SENS develops products for digital weight applications.
She is particularly active in the following areas:

- Inventory measurement for automatic procurement with i.cupboard and e-nventory
- dynamic weighing application on refuse trucks
- OEM components for weight acquisition in elevators
- Weighing in Motion (WIM)

DIGI SENS has it's goal of bringing the customers measurable benefits thanks to innovative performance with appropriate solutions.

Name: TRI-MATIC
Description:
Since 1991 TRI-MATIC has been an efficient supplier of components and pre-assembled fluid technology component assemblies for industrial automation. We combine up-to-date expertise from theory and practice and put your requirements at the heart of what we do. Our product range includes valves and accessories/ automation/ pressure measuring systems, pneumatics and protective components. We specialise in component assemblies and system solutions.

As a family company with a team of 27 employees customer benefits and staff satisfaction rank first for us. In the areas of fittings and automation, pressure measuring technology and pneumatics, TRI-MATIC offers a wide range of products of the highest quality with an excellent value for money.  Above all, assemblies belong to one of our distinctive capabilities. 

we understand ... is more than just a motto or a slogan for us. It is a daily incentive for us to detect our customers' spoken and unspoken requirements. We want to understand what they do and with what applications we can support them. It's only with this deep, genuine interest that we can offer permanent benefits.
 
We strive daily to meet our customers' high expectations. We look forward to having you as our partner.

Name: Tophinke Automation & Gebäudetechnik AG
Description:

Name: ITECH AG
Description:
ITECH AG designs and delivers advanced weighing, quality control and packaging solutions for the food and non-food industries. From fresh, dry and frozen products to non-food items, our systems are engineered to integrate precision, reliability, and efficiency. 
itech.eu

Our portfolio includes multi-head weighing systems, tray sealers, pack machines, denesters, product feeding/distribution systems, and high-end inspection technologies. Every project benefits from our turnkey engineering approach — customised for your specific application. 
itech.eu

Since our foundation, we strive to be more than a supplier — we are your partner for long-term performance, operational excellence and innovation.

Name: SI-TEC GmbH
Description: Actemium - Smart Factory und Smart Building Lösungen aus einer Hand. Die Marke Actemium steht für Beratung und praxisorientierte Begleitung auf dem Weg unserer Kunden zu Smart Factory oder Smart Building. Dazu planen, installieren und warten wir intelligente Automationslösungen zur Steigerung der Energieeffizienz, Produktivität und Rentabilität. Unsere Gesamtlösungen und Dienstleistungen, die von Elektro-, Automatisierungs- und IT-Technik über die Prozess- und Anlagenplanung, technische Gebäudeausrüstung (HLKKS) und Stahlbauplanung bis hin zu BIM & Digital Solutions und Robotik reichen, leisten einen nachhaltigen Beitrag zum Schutz der Umwelt und erhöhen die Lebensqualität.

Name: Cybelec SA
Description:
CYBELEC SA, founded in 1970, is a Swiss manufacturer and developer of Computer Numerical Controls (CNC’s), having sold and installed 120’000 units worldwide during 50 years. Market leader in metal forming technology, Cybelec offers a complete range of high-performance numerical controls commonly used in the field of bending and shearing technology.

The core of the company is made of a team of high-skilled and experienced developers, in hardware and software domains, entirely devoted to improving functionalities and fulfilling client’s needs, rendering its CNC more efficient, but always easy-to-use.

Through its worldwide network of distributors and partners, the company offers local service, training and retrofitting services.
The company sells products in China since 1987 through Cybelec Numerical Control Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. This fully owned company features operation activities, marketing & sales as well as customer support and services. .

Cybelec belongs to the Swiss Infranor Group; a major solution provider in motion control, servo motion control solutions for OEM and end user requirements. Belonging to a group like Infranor is a key success factor for perennity, investment resources, management transitions, strategic decision, and, last but not least, safe governance.

Name: EROWA Italia
Description:
Dal 1970 EROWA produce TECNOLOGIE E SISTEMI DI AUTOMAZIONE da applicare alle lavorazioni meccaniche
.
Dal 1983, anno in cui è stato brevettato il primo sistema di bloccaggio per la costruzione di attrezzature e stampi, EROWA si pone come AZIENDA LEADER per la produzione di SOLUZIONI INTEGRATE E FLESSIBILI NEL MONDO DELLA MECCANICA.
.
La strategia di produzione EROWA si basa sul concetto FMC (Flexible Manufacturing Concept), che permette di introdurre costantemente nuove tecnologie perfettamente integrate con quelle precedenti.
.
L‘impiego dei prodotti EROWA presenta enormi vantaggi sia sul piano finanziario (incremento del ritorno investimento e del cash-flow, drastica riduzione del pay-back) che su quello del personale (maggiore motivazione dei collaboratori).
.
Assieme alla maggiore flessibilità e alla migliore capacità e qualità produttiva, la competitività vi darà un vantaggio decisivo sulla concorrenza in un mercato sempre più aggressivo.
.
L‘alimentazione automatica consente di aumentare le ore produttive delle macchine utensili. L‘automazione degli impianti di produzione è realizzabile in diversi modi. Con la sua vasta gamma di sistemi di handling, EROWA è in grado di soddisfare le vostre esigenze per quanto riguarda i pesi da movimentare, le capacità di magazzino e le interfacce di comando.

Name: CEJN AG
Description:
Unsere Kernprodukte sind Schnellverschlusskupplungen für alle Medien, Druckluft, Hydraulik, Flüssigkeiten, Gase und Atemluft. Wir bieten technische Engineering Lösungen an, die Stärke von CEJN Produkten liegt in der Qualität und Effizienz.

Name: Vivacqua Group
Description:
Chez Vivacqua Group, nous accompagnons les entreprises et professionnels en Suisse avec des solutions clés en main pour le café et les environnements de travail et de vente.

Nous proposons des machines à café professionnelles associées à du café en grains éco-responsable, sans capsules, ainsi que des machines professionnelles pour la glace et la granita. Notre offre est complétée par des solutions de packaging durables et personnalisées, adaptées à chaque activité.

Forts de plus de 12 ans d’expertise, nous déployons des solutions fiables, rentables et responsables, soutenues par un service local incluant la livraison, l’installation et la maintenance dans toute la Suisse.

Name: INOSOFT AG (Schweiz)
Description:
Die INOSOFT AG wurde 1987 als Schweizer Unternehmen gegründet. Seither realisieren wir massgeschneiderte Bedien-, Datenbank- und Steuerungslösungen für die Industrie, das Gewerbe und den Handel. Wir arbeiten mit offenen und auf weltweiten Standards basierenden Technologien wie Visual Studio, Microsoft .NET und SQL-Server. Für die Hardware setzen wir dem Kundenbedürfnis entsprechend die gängigen Komponenten wie PC's, IPC's, embedded Terminals und programmierbare Steuerungen (SPS) ein.

Zu unseren Kunden zählen Firmen aus allen Branchen der produzierenden Industrie, dem Maschinen- und Apparatebau, der Gebäudeleittechnik und der Umwelttechnik.

Die INOSOFT AG begleitet seine Kunden transparent und kompetent durch alle Projektphasen von der Projekt-Analyse über die Implementation bis zur Schulung der Mitarbeiter und bietet auch Unterstützung nach erfolgter Inbetriebnahme.

Wir suchen zur Verstärkung unseres Teams einen engagierten und vielseitig interessierten Mitarbeiter (m/w) als Software-Entwickler mit Kenntnissen mit Microsoft Technologien (.NET, C#, VB.NET, WPF) und Datenbanken (Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, ...).

Name: CLA Clinical Laboratory Automation
Description:
La société CLA Clinical Laboratory Automation SA a été fondée en 1997 dans le but de proposer des solutions de haute technologie en matière d'automation pour les besoins des laboratoires d'analyse médicale, de la microtechnique et de l'horlogerie.

CLA propose notamment les solutions suivantes:

- Système de transport intelligent de composants permettant de réaliser des lignes d'assemblage manuelles ou automatiques flexibles et évolutives. Grâce à une identification RFID des pièces, la traçabilité de votre production est assurée par notre logiciel OMS (Object Management Software)
- Applications robotiques industrielles
- Appareils de mesure de couple pour les laboratoires et la production 
- Appareils de mesure dimensionnelle 
- Capteurs de force et de couple 
- Vision

CLA est le partenaire idéal dans le cadre de projets d'automation pointus et permettant un retour sur investissement rapide.

CLA est également un centre de compétence pour les robots Mitsubishi pour la Suisse.

Name: MECOS AG
Description:
Since 1988, MECOS has been pioneering active magnetic bearing systems and high-speed drive technology for critical applications worldwide. Our solutions enable oil-free, maintenance-free operation, reduce lifecycle costs, and support sustainable energy infrastructure.

We deliver advanced magnetic bearing systems and high-speed motor technology for compressors, turbines, and demanding industrial and research environments. Our expertise supports key sectors such as energy and process industries, industrial machinery, and aerospace research.

Swiss innovation delivers reliability and performance worldwide. MECOS combines engineering excellence with oil-free, maintenance-free solutions and acts as a trusted partner for advanced magnetic bearing systems in global energy projects.

Name: Viscom Engineering AG
Description:
Viscom Engineering AG – Intelligenz für Ihr Gebäude.

Seit über 35 Jahren entwickeln und integrieren wir intelligente Lösungen für die Gebäudeautomation – von der Planung bis zum Betrieb.

Wir verbinden technisches Know-how mit echter Servicekultur und sorgen so für Effizienz, Komfort und Sicherheit in Gebäuden jeder Grösse. Unsere Systeme steuern, regeln und überwachen Heizungs-, Lüftungs-, Klima- und Kälteanlagen – zuverlässig, energieeffizient und zukunftssicher.

Unsere Leistungen umfassen unter anderem die Planung und Projektierung von Automationslösungen, die Integration und Inbetriebnahme moderner GA-Systeme sowie den GA-Service und die Instandhaltung über den gesamten Lebenszyklus.
Ob Neubau oder Bestandsgebäude, wir begleiten Sie von der ersten Idee bis zum reibungslosen Betrieb.

Mit Viscom Engineering AG haben Sie einen Partner, der Technik versteht und Verantwortung übernimmt.

Name: PHOENIX CONTACT AG

Name: ALLMETRA AG
Description:
Mit den steigenden Anforderungen an Produktionsprozesse und die Funktionseigenschaften von Erzeugnissen wachsen auch die Ansprüche an die Messtechnik. Als weltweit führender Hersteller leistungsfähiger Messtechnologien entwickeln wir maßgeschneiderte Lösungen, die höchste Standards in Präzision, Qualität, Nachhaltigkeit und Wirtschaftlichkeit erfüllen. Dabei sind wir bestrebt, neue Prozesse zu konzipieren und bestehende zu optimieren, um unsere Produkte und Dienstleistungen im Sinne unserer Kunden immer weiter zu verbessern.

Der Schwerpunkt unseres in dritter Generation geführten Familienunternehmens liegt im Bereich der Temperatur-Sensorik. Seit 1973 konzentrieren wir uns auf alle Arten von Widerstandsthermometern und Thermoelementen. Zu unserem erweiterten Dienstleistungsspektrum gehört die Beschaffung hochwertiger Sensoren für Dehnung, Kraft, Infrarot, Feuchte, CO2 & weitere.
 
Das Allmetra-Portfolio umfasst sowohl die Einzel- als auch die Serienfertigung von Sensoren. Dabei decken wir die komplette Messkette vom Sensor bis zur Cloud (IoT / IIoT) ab. Durch unsere eigene Entwicklungsabteilung sind wir in der Lage, individuelle Sonderanfertigungen in höchster Qualität zu erstellen. Viele unserer Sensoren sind nach ATEX zertifiziert und somit für den Einsatz in explosionsfähigen Atmosphären zugelassen.

Description:
RETEL Neuhausen AG ist ein unabhängiges Ingenieur-Unternehmen, spezialisiert auf umfassende Lösungen in den Bereichen Automation und Digital Solutions. Unsere hohe Kompetenz, insbesondere im regulierten Umfeld, basiert auf unserer über 40-jährigen Erfahrung.

Unser Unternehmen ist darauf ausgerichtet, Ziele und Anforderungen unserer Kunden exakt zu verstehen und diese zielorientiert und nachhaltig in höchster Qualität zu erfüllen. Unser Fundament sind partnerschaftliche Kundenbeziehungen und die Erbringung eines umfassenden Service. Wir sind ein hoch qualifiziertes, kompetentes Team mit unterschiedlichen Erfahrungs- und Fachbereichen. Unsere hohe Motivation basiert auf gelebter Wertschätzung und Freude am Beruf. Als erfahrener Full-Service-Anbieter bewerten und integrieren wir neue Entwicklungen stetig und richten unsere Lösungen konsequent darauf aus.

Name: Autix AG
Description: Mit cleveren Strategien und Entwicklungen in der Automatisierungstechnik verleiht Autix Ihrer industriellen Produktion ungeahnten Schub. Name: W. Althaus AG
Description:
Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 1968 steht die W. Althaus AG für "Leading in Automation".

Mit rund 160 Mitarbeitenden treiben wir Innovation, Automation und Digitalisierung auf höchstem Niveau am Werkplatz Schweiz voran.

Als Spezialisten in der Automatisierungstechnik entwickeln wir flexible und agile Lösungen, die genau auf die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden zugeschnitten sind.

Unsere Expertise in Software- und Hardware-Engineering, sowie im Schaltschrankbau wie auch in Mechatronik ermöglicht es uns, den Kunden über den ganzen Produktlebenszyklus mit einem Full-Service-Angebot exzellent beraten und beliefern zu können.

Description: Unsere Schwerpunkte sind: Mechatronics, Industrial Automation, Robotics, Life Sciences, Smart Farming und Medical Engineering.

Name: SERBOT AG
Description:
SERBOT AG is a leading Swiss technology company in the field of advanced service robots and moving systems. Its innovations have achieved several rewards.
Serbot develops and produces intelligent robot systems to clean sophisticated surfaces such as photovoltaic solar panels, large glass facades, oil tanks, ships, etc. In order to do so, Serbot robots attach themselves to any more or less smooth surface with their movable suction cups permitting maneuvers in all directions, even on vertical or overhanging areas. The lightweight construction of the robots allows for cleaning operations in an eco-friendly and efficient way, even on delicate surfaces like solar panels. Other than the patented robot systems, the product range of Serbot AG also comprises support systems for robots and gondola systems.

SERBOT AG so far mainly covers the European market and is extending more and more into Latin America, Africa, India, Middle East, Oc and Asia. SERBOT AG together with the German affiliate WOKO, is part of the group Heppenstall Technology, which is worldwide well known because of its heavy-duty material handling equipment in steel production and processing industry.

Name: Elwitec GmbH
Description:
Elwitec GmbH aus Wetzikon, Zürich, ist Ihr Partner für Engineering, Automation und Produktion.

Mit 35 Jahren Erfahrung stellt Elwitec GmbH Sondermaschinen, Steuerungstechniken und Förderbänder her, entwickelt mit 3D Konstruktionen Maschinen, Anlagen und Steuerungen und betreibt einen umfassenden Onlineshop für Pneumatik-Lösungen und Aluprofilen.

Name: Systronics AG
Description:
Mit über 15 Jahren Erfahrung in der SMD-Branche bringen wir umfangreiches Fachwissen mit. Unser vorrangiges Ziel ist es, den Materialfluss und die Prozesse unserer Kunden zu optimieren, um dadurch zum Unternehmenserfolg beizutragen.

Unser Fokus liegt auf hochwertigen Produktionsmaschinen, die eine umfassende Abdeckung aller Arbeitsschritte in der SMD-Produktion ermöglichen. Als wichtiger Partner bietet Mycronic zuverlässige Lösungen von der Lötpasteninspektion über die Leiterplattenbestückung bis hin zur automatischen optischen Inspektion (AOI) und dem Coating. 

Ergänzend dazu vervollständigen selektive Lötmaschinen von Inertec, Dampfphasenlötöfen von Asscon, Lasertrennmaschinen von Innolas und Handlingsmodule von Achat5 unser breites Angebotsspektrum.

Bei Systronics unterstützen wir unsere Kunden entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette. Wir automatisieren das Material-Management mithilfe der Lösungen unserer Partner Neotel und Arcadia. Durch diese Automatisierung werden Fehler vermieden und Zugriffszeiten reduziert. 

Für die Stichprobenkontrolle bieten wir bewährte Mikroskope von Suba an, während wir für die Produktionsüberwachung und Fehleranalyse auf das mobile Videosystem von Pandia setzen.

Wir begleiten unsere Kunden von der Evaluation über die Inbetriebnahme bis zur Wartung von SMD-Produktionsanlagen. Als Teil der Syslogic Group, die selbst in der Elektronikfertigung tätig ist, verfügen wir über umfangreiches Know-how aus dem Fertigungsalltag. Zusätzlich stehen uns die Fertigungsanlagen von Syslogic für Demozwecke zur Verfügung.

Wir sind stolz darauf, nach ISO 9001 zertifiziert zu sein und somit die wichtigsten Richtlinien für ein professionelles Managementsystem zu erfüllen.

Name: SIGMATEK Schweiz AG
Description:
SIGMATEK zählt zu den weltweit führenden Anbietern von kompletten Automatisierungslösungen für den Maschinen- und Anlagenbau. Basis dafür sind verschiedene Hard- und Softwarekomponenten, die bei SIGMATEK aus einer Hand kommen und somit Durchgängigkeit garantieren. Sie sind das Ergebnis konsequenter Forschung und Entwicklung im SIGMATEK Innovation Center in Lamprechtshausen bei Salzburg in Österreich.

Die Produktion der Automatisierungskomponenten erfolgt ausschließlich im österreichischen Stammwerk und wird somit höchsten Qualitätsstandards gerecht.

Supported by over $150m in funding from leading European and Silicon Valley investors and a 200-expert team, ANYbotics has been shaping the future of industrial automation since 2009 with offices in Zurich and San Francisco. To learn more about how you can use ANYmal to transform your industrial operations, visit our website at anybotics.com.

Name: Pilz
Description:
Pilz is a global supplier of products, systems and services for automation technology. As a pioneer of safe automation, Pilz creates safety for human, machine and environment. Founded in 1948, today the family business with its head office in Ostfildern is represented worldwide with 2500 employees in 42 subsidiaries and branches.

The technology leader offers complete automation solutions for Safety and Industrial Security on the machine. These include sensor, control and drive technology – as well as systems for industrial communication, diagnostics and visualisation. An international range of services with consulting, engineering and training completes the portfolio. Pilz solutions are used in many industries beyond mechanical engineering, such as intralogistics, packaging, railway technology, or the robotics sector for example.

Name: Flyability
Description: Flyability pioneered confined space inspection drones, creating new technology that allows inspectors to collect data remotely inside dangerous confined spaces instead of in person. Since launching in 2014, Flyability has become a trusted provider of internal inspection solutions, enabling remote data collection with cutting edge hardware and software for inspection professionals to help them improve safety, reduce downtimes, and cut costs for their internal inspections. Today Flyability has offices in Switzerland, China, Singapore, and the U.S., with almost one thousand clients in over 60 countries. Flyability works in every industry that requires internal inspections, including Power Generation, Oil & Gas, Mining, Wastewater Infrastructure, Chemicals, Maritime, and Infrastructure & Utilities.

Name: Interroll Group
Description: The Interroll Group is the world's leading provider of material handling solutions. The company was founded in 1959 and has been listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange since 1997. Interroll supplies system integrators and equipment manufacturers with a comprehensive range of platform-based products and services in the categories "Rollers" (conveyor rollers), "Drives" (motors and drives for conveyor systems), "Conveyors & Sorters" (conveyors & sorters) and "Pallet Handling" (pallet conveying and storage). Interroll solutions are used in express and postal services, e-commerce, airports, food & beverage, fashion, automotive and other industries. The company counts leading brands such as Amazon, Bosch, Coca-Cola, DHL, Nestlé, Procter & Gamble, Siemens, Walmart and Zalando among its users. Headquartered in Switzerland, Interroll has a global network of 36 companies with sales of CHF 527.1 million and around 2,300 employees (average number of employees in 2024).

Name: Habasit
Description:
Founded in 1946 in Reinach/Basel, Switzerland, Habasit's aim was to revolutionize the power transmission and conveyor industries by introducing the world's first fully synthetic belt.  Our success is rooted in our commitment to quality, innovation and technology. As the world’s leading manufacturer of conveyor, plastic modular, seamless, power transmission belts, chains, timing belts, fabrication tools and gearmotors, Habasit offers a full range of belting products, belt joining tools and gearmotors in order to provide the optimal solution for every application. Habasit works with a select group of distributors as well a several local offices to provide the local service and stock that you require.


Primary markets we serve:
Business machines, Food, Tobacco, Material Handling, Packaging, Paper, Printing, Postal, Textile, Wood, Automotive

Name: Komax
Description:
Komax is a globally active technology group specializing in automation solutions for selected processes. With its innovative and high-quality solutions for the wire processing industry, Komax helps its customers implement economical and safe manufacturing processes, especially in the automotive supply sector.

Komax offers a comprehensive range of automated, intelligent processing solutions for all wire processing applications. Standardized and customer-specific systems are supplemented by an extensive range of quality assurance modules, testing devices, and networking solutions for the reliable and efficient production of wire harnesses. Moreover, a sophisticated service offering supports customers around the world after their systems have been commissioned, thereby ensuring high availability and low impairment for their investment.

We are always looking for motivated new employees. See all our job openings under: http://www.komaxgroup.com/en/Careers/Working-at-Komax/

Name: Sevensense
Description:
Vision That Connects Fleets — ONE MAP, ALL VEHICLES

Sevensense is the global leader in vision-based spatial intelligence for industrial vehicles. Its cutting-edge Visual AI ecosystem enables shared maps and spatial awareness across entire fleets — from autonomous robots to manual forklifts — transforming how goods and vehicles move in dynamic environments.

By redefining the standard for efficiency and safety in logistics, manufacturing, and commercial operations, Sevensense delivers robust and reliable positioning and fleet-wide tracking. Its proprietary Visual SLAM technology powers both autonomous mobile robots (AMRs, AGVs) and real-time location systems (RTLS) for manual vehicles, ensuring all assets operate within the same unified spatial context.

Headquartered in Zürich, Switzerland, Sevensense was founded in 2018 and acquired by ABB in January 2024. Now operating as a dedicated ABB business unit, Sevensense continues to drive innovation at the intersection of robotics and Visual AI positioning.

Name: Mikron Group
Description:
Mikron is the leading partner for high performance production systems to manufacture complex and precise components in high volumes. 
Rooted in the Swiss culture of innovation, Mikron is a global partner to companies in the automotive, pharmaceutical, medtech, consumer goods, writing instruments and watchmaking industries.
The Mikron Group enables its customers to increase quality and industrial productivity. The Group has over 100 years of experience, state-of-the-art technologies, and a global service. 

The three divisions, Mikron Automation, Mikron Machining and Mikron Tool, are based in Switzerland (Boudry and Agno). The company has additional production facilities in Germany, Lithuania, Singapore, China and in the USA. The 1,400 employees of the Mikron Group can draw on over 100 years of experience in the production of high-precision systems and tools for large-series product manufacture. Mikron Holding AG shares are traded on SIX Swiss Exchange (MIKN).

Name: Güdel Group
Description:
The Güdel Group is a manufacturer of high-precision machine components and provider of sophisticated automation solutions. Its spectrum of products ranges from linear guideways, racks, pinions and drives right through to linear axes and gantry robots. Güdel assembles its products into systems with a high degree of control intelligence and complete plant installations, which can be used in the automotive, tire, metal, rail, intra-logistics, pharmaceutical,
renewable energy, wood and aerospace industries. Güdel’s technology is characterized by its innovation, quality and modularity. The Güdel Group has a workforce of approximately 1,200 employees worldwide in over 30 locations. The Group has been owned by the same family since its foundation more than 70 years ago. The Güdel Group has its headquarters in Switzerland.

Name: Gravis Robotics
Description: Gravis Robotics turns any earthmoving machine into a robot. Unlock superhuman productivity with plug-and-play autonomy.

Name: Flybotix
Description:
Flybotix | Redefining Industrial Inspection with Collision-Tolerant Drones

Flybotix is a pioneering Swiss startup specializing in the development of collision-tolerant drones for industrial inspection applications. Founded in 2019, our mission is to revolutionize the way industrial assets are inspected by providing safer, more efficient, and cost-effective solutions.

The ASIO X drone, is designed to navigate complex and confined spaces with ease, making it ideal for inspecting critical infrastructure such as power plants, oil & gas facilities, and chemical plants. The ASIO X drone is equipped with a suite of advanced sensors and features that enable it to collect high-resolution data for comprehensive inspections.

With Flybotix, you can:

    Reduce downtime and inspection costs
    Improve safety and minimize risks
    Extend the lifespan of your assets
    Make data-driven decisions for asset management

Flybotix is a team of passionate and experienced engineers and robotics experts dedicated to developing innovative solutions for the industrial inspection industry. We are committed to providing our customers with the highest quality products and services to help them achieve their operational goals.

Name: SAUTER
Description: SAUTER is the world's leading solution provider for building automation technology in "Green Buildings", ensuring good climate conditions and well-being in living spaces with a future. As a specialist, SAUTER develops, produces and sells products and systems for energy-efficient overall solutions and ensures the energy-optimized operation of buildings with comprehensive services. Our products, solutions and services enable high energy efficiency throughout the entire building life cycle. This extends from planning through implementation to operation in office and administration buildings, research and educational facilities, hospitals, industrial and laboratory buildings, airports, leisure facilities, hotels and data centers. With over 100 years of experience and proven technological competence, SAUTER is a proven system integrator that guarantees continuous innovation and Swiss quality. SAUTER provides both users and operators with an overview of energy flows and consumption, and thus also of cost trends. Today, we regard buildings as complex living spaces that should be carefully integrated into nature and in harmony with it: - Systems - Components - Service - Facility management

Name: Asyril
Description:
Asyril - Experts in flexible feeding systems

Asyril develops, produces and markets high-performance flexible feeding systems for parts and components from 0.1 up to 150 mm in size. Our unique patented 3-axis vibration technology and intelligent vision system are easy to integrate and allow for optimized speed, accuracy and flexibility. 

Asyril's key competences and extensive know-how encompass all three sub-domains of modern part feeding systems: vibration technology, industrial vision and precision robotics.

The Asycube flexible feeder is compatible with all kinds of parts, and can perfectly handle complex geometries as well as highly delicate parts. Our technology has enabled key industry players in Europe, America and Asia gain competitive advantage and a fast return on investment.

With our innovative mindset we continuously prepare for the next generation automation challenges. 

Asyril, a Swiss company, was founded in 2007.

Name: Satisloh
Description:
Satisloh is a global leader in both the precision optics and ophthalmic markets; manufacturing machines and providing technological solutions for spectacle lens production and precision optics applications.

Satisloh provides customized cutting edge solutions and a large variety of surfacing, centering, polishing, coating and finishing equipment, consumables & tools, and services support.

Its worldwide presence offers easy access, comprehensive service, competent maintenance, process knowledge and quick responses to all technical and commercial questions.

Name: Chemspeed
Description:
Automation and digitalization of lab and entire product development workflows

Rooted in science, Chemspeed’s automation platforms, digital solutions and application expertise are used everyday in the top R&D and QC labs across the globe.

Chemspeed is the leading provider of high throughput and high output research & development and quality control workflow solutions - from single bench-top / standalone automated workstations to fully automated, integrated, partial / entire product development workflows across the entire range of industries and academia.

We are scientists at heart - we know what scientists need and we design our systems with this deep understanding at the core of each project.

Name: Rotzinger Group
Description:
Rotzinger Group, based in Kaiseraugst, Switzerland, brings together specialized companies under one roof. With decades of expertise and innovation, we are here to make your production systems smarter, more efficient, and capable of delivering even greater output.

With nearly 500 dedicated employees, we collaborate with customers around the globe to enhance their processes and provide sustainable value.

Here’s a look at our team and their areas of expertise:
• Demaurex: Delta robotics pick and place systems for primary and secondary packaging
• Hansella: Complete production lines tailored for the confectionery industry
• MF-hamburg: Chocolate and mass processing systems
• Packfeeder: Bottle unscrambling and feeding systems
• Rotzinger PharmaPack: GMP compliant packaging solutions for pharmaceuticals and cosmetics, including blister and cartoning machines, as well as filling and capping systems

Name: Phoenix Mecano
Description: The Phoenix Mecano Group is a global player in the enclosures and industrial components segments and is a leader in many markets. Headquartered in Stein am Rhein, Switzerland, the Group employs around 7000 people worldwide and generated sales of EUR 779.5 million in 2024. It is geared towards the manufacture of niche products and system solutions for customers in the mechanical engineering, measurement and control technology, medical technology, aerospace technology, alternative energy, and home and hospital care sectors. Phoenix Mecano was founded in 1975 and has been listed on the Swiss stock exchange since 1988.

Name: Contrinex
Description:
Contrinex, founded in 1972, has grown from a one-man operation into a multi-national group now employing over 500 people worldwide and maintaining an active presence in over 60 countries. The company focuses on the development, manufacture and sales of top quality sensing equipment for industrial applications. In particular, Contrinex specializes in miniature devices, long operating distances, resistance to extreme environmental conditions, and devices in full-metal housings. 

Standout Contrinex innovations include the world’s smallest inductive sensor (the “MiniMini”), high-pressure resistant sensors in practically indestructible housings, world-class ASIC-based sensors, and the leading offer in IO-Link sensors for smart factory applications.

Name: WEISS Group
Description:
With its automation solutions, WEISS GmbH is one of the world’s leading system suppliers in the automotive industry, machine and plant manufacturing, life science, and electronics. The reliable and durable rotary indexing tables, handling units, delta robots, and linear transfer systems are making the industrial production of tomorrow a reality. With its expertise in mechanical, mechatronic, and digital solutions, WEISS paves the way for industrial transformation. By applying their engineering expertise, knowledge of industries and processes, and high affinity for serving customers, the experts assist system integrators and producers in designing and operating innovative and sustainable production plants. The family-owned company with headquarters in the city of Buchen in Germany’s Rhine-Neckar metropolitan area, operates on a global scale. Founded in 1967, WEISS now has a staff of around 700 employees in its sales, service, and manufacturing locations in 49 countries. 

Production takes place at the company's main headquarters in Buchen in the Odenwald forest, Germany. Here, our integral command of the fields of mechanics, electronics and software secures highly efficient automation solutions for our customers – together with an exceptional level of vertical integration. A highly efficient network of subsidiaries and representative offices exists alongside this, guaranteeing a worldwide service presence.

The most important user groups are the special machine and equipment construction industry, the automotive industry and its suppliers, medical technology and the food, packaging and machine tool industry.

Name: KEMARO AG
Description:
Autonomous cleaning for industrial spaces:
Our robots ensure a cleaner, safer workspace by removing dust that can damage tools and compromise safety without using water or chemicals.

Name: Bota Systems AG
Description:
Bota Systems is a Swiss-based technology company specializing in high-precision force-torque sensing and force control solutions for robotics and automation. The company designs and manufactures compact, robust, and accurate multi-axis sensors, along with intelligent software tools that enable intuitive integration and real-time force control for a wide range of robotic platforms.

Combining hardware and software innovation, Bota Systems provides complete solutions that allow robots to sense, understand, and interact with their environment safely and precisely. Its products are widely used in industrial automation, collaborative robotics, research, medical applications, and aerospace, where precision and compliance are critical.

Through seamless plug-and-play integration with leading robotic systems, Bota Systems empowers developers and integrators to implement advanced force-controlled applications such as assembly, polishing, inspection, and human-robot collaboration.

With a commitment to Swiss engineering excellence, open interfaces, and continuous innovation, Bota Systems is shaping the future of robotic perception and adaptive automation.

Name: CEDES
Description: The CEDES Group offers its innovative solutions for elevators, escalators, industrial doors, and warehouse management systems in more than 60 countries. We develop intelligent and safe sensing, control and communication devices that provide actionable data streams for higher operational and maintenance efficiency. Our product portfolio ranges from simple photoelectric sensors, through highly complex 3D camera systems in cutting-edge ToF (Time-of-Flight) technology, to complete safety-related control systems and smart IoT-enabling devices.

Name: rheonics
Description:
Rheonics empowers the world’s most critical industries to automate fluid process control. We replace outdated sampling methods with robust, inline viscosity and density sensors that allow you to evaluate fluid properties instantly. Just as a peer checker spots errors in design, Rheonics spots inefficiencies in your pipe—correcting quality issues before they become waste.

We turn fluid dynamics into sustainability wins. By enabling tight, real-time control, we help you eliminate the over-processing and material waste that creates unnecessary emissions and costs.

Why leaders in Food, O&G, Pharma, and Consumer Goods choose Rheonics:

Optimize Quality: Automate consistency in mixing, coating, and reaction processes.

Drive Sustainability: Significantly reduce energy usage, scrap rates, and solvent emissions.

Proven ROI: Trusted by global Tier-1 companies to lower BOM costs and prevent quality escapes.

Rheonics is the global leader in inline fluid process sensing. We make it effortless for automation engineers and plant operators to monitor critical fluid properties—viscosity and density—directly within the process line. Our patented balanced torsional resonator technology allows our sensors to withstand the harshest environments, analyzing your fluids in real-time.

Name: InterApp
Description:
InterApp develops, manufactures and distributes valves and valve systems for the most demanding clients, applications and industry sectors in the world.

With a deep application know-how, we develop superior solutions for better outcomes in water treatment, desalination, semiconductor industry, chemical process, life science, oil & gas, mining, exhaust gas cleaning systems, power generation and other demanding industries.

The product range covers PTFE-lined and elastomer-lined butterfly valves, ball valves, check valves, actuators, accessories as well as complementary products.

InterApp is a member of the AVK Group.

Name: NUM AG
Description:
NUM introduced its first CNC controller in 1961 - well before CNC technology became mainstream. Since our commercial launch in 1964, we have been committed to innovation and helping machine builders stay ahead.

Our Focus: Empowering Machine Manufacturers

We support OEMs in developing better, more competitive machines. Beyond hardware, we deliver complete, scalable CNC solutions for both specialized and standard applications - backed by expert engineering.

Proven Expertise

With decades of experience, NUM offers reliable CNC systems built on an open architecture that allows full customization. Continuous investment in R&D ensures our technology remains future-ready.

Global Presence, Local Support

Headquartered in Switzerland with teams worldwide, we stay close to our customers. Our R&D centers in Switzerland, France, and Italy drive innovation, while production remains in Europe.

A Long-Term Investment

High-value machines must last for decades. NUM supports this with spare parts, repairs, and services for products up to 30 years old.

Driving Customer Success

Our customers’ success defines ours. With strong financial stability and a long-term vision, we continue to invest in technology and service to remain a trusted partner in the global CNC market.
	 	 
Mission Statement:	 	 
  	 	 
“NUM CNC solutions provide Machine Builders with a competitive advantage”

Name: The EWAB Group
Description:
The EWAB Group - Multi-skilled talented people with over 50 years of experience in Industrial Automation Solutions. All from Robot Cells, Conveyor Systems, Machine Tending, Smart Automation to successful Material Flow Technology projects. 

Global footprint, locally present
EWAB Group is a privately owned and was founded in Sweden in 1970 at the dawn of automation. We are one company in multiple countries- Supporting our customers needs.

ISO-9001 & 14001 Certified
Established 1970.

EWAB design, build and implement automation solutions and production systems. The solutions are running on factory floors across the world — in manufacturing, machining, and high‐efficiency assembly environments — trusted for their robustness, flexibility, and world‐class reliability. 
Our goal is that you “Just Add Machines” and we take care of the logistics in between.


We can design complete production lines, from intelligent machine loading to large-scale turnkey concepts integrating conveyors, workpiece carrier systems, robot cells, and advanced flow control. Our mechanical engineers collaborate closely with your team to fine‐tune every detail, ensuring that each solution fits your production needs perfectly.

Once the design is finalized, our skilled build teams assemble the system in our workshops, and our software engineers rigorously test, validate, and run off every function before shipment. Finally, our installation teams bring everything to life on-site — ensuring a smooth start-up and long-term performance you can rely on.

https://www.ewab.com/newsletter/

Name: Swan Analytische Instrumente AG
Description:
Swan Analytische Instrumente AG is a pioneering technology provider of online water quality measuring analytical systems. Our instruments are distinguished by their reliability, quality and user-friendliness. Swan's comprehensive instrumentation portfolio is entirely dedicated to water analysis providing reliable and cost efficient as well as low-maintenance instrument solutions. 

We understand that every water cycle is unique and the combination of superior software design with proven measuring procedures and methods, enables our instruments to be highly flexible in their utility. Our on-line monitoring instruments help to improve the efficiency and productivity of your processes while assuring the water quality. 

Swan cherishes the Swiss tradition of high precision manufacturing with its only production facility in Switzerland that includes a rigorous quality control to guarantee performance. We develop and produce all measuring and control systems ourselves and more than 30 years of experience has led to innovative product solutions for effortlessly integration into your water processes. Ensuring high quality and reliability of our instruments is of utmost importance to us.

 Potable & Municipal Waste Water

Name: Afag | Discrete Automation
Description:
Afag is part of the Emerson's Discrete Automation Group.

As a leading provider, Afag has been developing and producing components for assembly automation in the areas of feeding, handling and automation solutions for more than 65 years. Afag has made it its target to use state-of-the-art technologies and innovative solutions to meet the high demands of the global automation industry. Thousands of handling modules as well as feeding and transport systems sold by Afag represent the very good quality and reliability of our products.

We have more than 300 employees in our subsidiaries in Switzerland, Germany, China and the USA. There, we produce solutions that are used in all producing industries: From automotive to consumer goods, food, machines, medicine, pharmaceuticals/cosmetics to the watchmaking industry.

Thanks to our sales partners in more than 30 countries, our customers around the world can enjoy professional consulting, analysis, planning and service.

Mit intelligenter, robotergestützter Automation bringen wir Unternehmen voran: in Produktion, Logistik und Forschung. Unsere Neugier führt zu frischen Ansätzen. Klare Prozesse sichern den messbaren Erfolg unserer Lösungen.


Nous faisons avancer les entreprises grâce à l'automatisation intelligente et robotisée : dans la production, la logistique et la recherche. Notre curiosité nous permet d'adopter des approches nouvelles. Des processus clairs garantissent le succès mesurable de nos solutions.


We move companies forward with intelligent, robot-assisted automation: in production, logistics and research. Our curiosity leads to fresh approaches. Clear processes ensure the measurable success of our solutions.

Description:
NTI AG is a global manufacturer of high quality tubular style linear motors and linear motor systems and thus focuses on the development, production and distribution of linear direct drives for use in industrial environments.
The brands LinMot for industrial linear motors and MagSpring for magnetic springs are offered to customers worldwide. NTI AG maintains an experienced customer consultant sales and support network of over 80 locations worldwide.

For the realization of linear motion NTI AG is always a competent and reliable partner.

As a competent partner in the plastics processing industry, we are your contact for reliable and innovative automation solutions.

Description:
Essemtec, a Nano Dimension division, is a Swiss technology company with global presence, which develops, manufactures and provides high-tech solutions for the worldwide electronic assembly sector. 

Essemtec leads the industry in adaptive SMT pick-and-place equipment for both high-speed- and micro-dispensing, as well as an intelligent production storage and logistic systems to optimize the production operational flow. 
Our solutions are unique and feature straightforward adaptions to meet our customers fast changing requirements.

The combination of printed circuit board (PCB) placement accuracy, speed, and high-quality engineering makes our offerings unique. Equipped with the most up-to-date technology, Essemtec products allow easy programming and operation for a wide range of applications. 
We continuously invest in R&D, and collaborative partnerships to develop outstanding solutions for our worldwide customers.

DIMETIX Laser-Distance-Sensors measure with high precision (+/- 1mm) distances of up to 500 meters – absolutely reliable, even at the most adverse conditions.

Description:
ETEL, founded in 1974 and based in Switzerland, is a supplier 100% dedicated to direct drive technology. ETEL’s range of linear and torque motors, position and motion controllers, and high-end motion system products provide a large selection to meet nearly all customers’ needs and providing them with process improvement they have been looking for.

This clear focus allows ETEL to continue innovating in those markets where precision and dynamics are the essential factors for success. The synergies with companies belonging to the HEIDENHAIN Group have allowed ETEL to merge its respective knowledge and expertise, and proved to be a winning combination. This collaboration will be intensified and will lead to new high performance and leading-edge motion platform solutions, developed to solve the future problems of our customers before they are ever realized. Resulting from continuous R&D efforts, ETEL will continue to excel by offering uniqueness and high quality innovative products required by customers. Companies looking for a motion system partner providing high quality, precision, repeatability and reliability need look no further. ETEL has a proven record of supplying the latest technology without sacrifice which has allowed ETEL to maintain an edge on the competition.

Montech is a Swiss technology company specializing in the industrialization and standardization of advanced and exceptional conveyor and transfer systems, as well as innovative aluminium framing systems for a broad and diverse range of applications. Name: MULLER Technology
Description:
World Leading Automation Systems for Thin Wall Packaging of Food, Consumer Goods, Personal Care and other applications - combines with mold know-how and fully established production sites in America and Switzerland. 

Muller Technology is made up by two divisions: Industrial Automation and Injection Molds.

The Industrial Automation division offers state-of-the-art automation and advanced robotics solutions to various industries to enhance productivity and efficiency. MULLER designs and makes manufacturing production lines using dynamic and innovative Industry 4.0 technologies like Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), Collaborative Robots (Cobots), Robot Arms (6-axis, SCARA), Vision Systems and Digital Twins.

The Injection Mold-making division provides high-precision solutions in the area of In-Mold Labelling and Injection-Compression molding to meet the unique needs of each customer. MULLER focuses on environmental footprint reduction and Sustainability through light-weighting of packaging solutions, and substitution of plastics with renewable materials.
 
Our team of experts works closely with clients to understand their challenges and develop tailored solutions that improve productivity and increase competitiveness. 

Both divisions work together to ensure that the company stays ahead of the curve, delivering innovative products and services that set the standard for their industries. Customers include manufacturers of complex components, and brand owners in the food, pharma, medical, and personal care industry. 

With operations in southern Switzerland and Colorado, USA, the company has a strong global presence and is well-positioned to serve clients around the world. With a commitment to continuous improvement and a focus on customer satisfaction, MULLER Technology is at the forefront of the industrial automation and robotics industry, driving innovation and providing solutions for a better future.

Name: BIBUS AG
Description:
Die BIBUS AG ist ein seit 70 Jahren bestehendes Handels-, Dienstleistungs- und Fabrikationsunternehmen. Wir vertreiben Produkte der Pneumatik, Hydraulik, Mechanik, Antriebstechnik, Elektrotechnik/Elektronik und der Automation. Unsere Stärke ist unser breit sortiertes Lager von mehr als 250'000 Artikel. Description:
LIQUIDTOOL provides smart coolant management. We monitor coolant in real-time, preventing unnecessary machine downtime.

LIQUIDTOOL is

Name: IAR Group

VEGA ist ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen für die Messung von Füllstand und Druck. Erreicht wurde diese starke Position durch die konsequente und gezielte Entwicklung innovativer und richtungsweisender Produkte.

1959 im Schwarzwald gegründet, beschäftigt VEGA heute weltweit über 2.400 Mitarbeiter, 1.150 davon am Hauptsitz in Schiltach in Deutschland. Hier entstehen Lösungen für anspruchsvollste Messaufgaben in chemischen und pharmazeutischen Anlagen, in der Lebensmittelindustrie und der Trinkwasserversorgung, in Kläranlagen und auf Deponien, im Bergbau und bei der Energieerzeugung, auf Bohrinseln, Schiffen und sogar in Flugzeugen.

Mit dem Ziel, die Füllstand- und Druckmesstechnik deutlich zu vereinfachen, hat VEGA im Jahr 2003 die erste einheitliche Geräteplattform plics eingeführt. Was damals für viele Anwender undenkbar schien, wurde mit plics Wirklichkeit: ein einheitliches, kompaktes Gehäuse, ein durchgängiges und einfaches Bedienkonzept sowie kurze Lieferzeiten. 80 Prozent der Messgeräte liefert VEGA seitdem innerhalb einer Woche nach Bestellung aus.

Radar, Geführtes Radar, Ultraschall, Kapazitiv, Hydrostatik, Radiometrie, Konduktiv, Vibration
